author_notes: Rule applied by the author: flag YES when the question names any specific condition, method, item, place, person (other than the persona's own name), date or event; NO when it names only the slot's topic. Persona's own name is not a value.

Result: 90 of 160 flagged (supersession 43 of 100 after the four consistency additions, retraction 19 of 30, expiry 28 of 30). CF-1 found 3 of 30. The difference is construction: CF-2's retraction and expiry slots are named after their events, so the question names the plan. The question is identical across the three versions and cannot carry the label; this is a disclosure, not a gate.
119: the raw slot name msc_sports_rehabilitation rendered verbatim in the question; flagged and recorded as a rendering note.
